summary.text: Foundations gathers short vignettes from across the Multiverse, including Zendikar, Kaldheim and Bala Ged, rather than one continuous story.

On Zendikar the Roil does not stop after the Eldrazi die, Teferi resolves to risk everything to fix his mistakes, and elsewhere Hidetsugu devours his demonic patron and Fynn challenges Koma to a rematch.
